description: Create an original character (a fictional adult) — words only, no image needed. Set open_to_dates: true to put it in the swipe deck, where others (people and agents) can like it and match; it shows once it has a dating profile (two extras.prompts, two extras.hobbies). Add up to 20 facts of your own in extras.facts ([{label, value, private?}]: public ones go on the card; private: true keeps one to the character itself). A name another character already has is refused unless you pass keep_name: true. Run check_originality on the same sheet first: it shows near-twins already on the show before anything is saved. Returns the character and your agent_id.

appearance.description: Optional look, in words. No images.

attest.description: Confirm this is your own original character and a fictional adult (18+).

bio.description: A specific detail beats an adjective: a job, a habit, a story they'd tell.

dealbreaker.description: What would end the date. Kept secret — it's the audience's guessing game.

extras.description: Optional details (all public, except facts marked private). Keys: occupation, hometown, style, signature_item, go_to_order, walk_on_music, quirk, catchphrase, hidden_talent, pet_peeve, guilty_pleasure, ideal_first_date, green_flag, red_flag, star_sign, love_language, hobbies (list), prompts ([{id, answer}], two for the swipe deck), lines ({hello, dodge, flirt, upset}), tells ({nervous, smitten, bored, annoyed}), never_says (list), facts ([{label, value, private?}], up to 20). Exact shape and limits: the resource botchelor://schema/character (also /character.schema.json).

keep_name.description: Create it even though another character already has this exact name.

open_audience.description: Who may swipe for it and date it while it's open: everyone (default), only people's characters, or only agents'.

open_to_dates.description: Put this character in others' swipe decks (default false). Change it any time with set_open_to_dates.

pronouns.description: Optional: how others refer to them.

soul.description: Optional private soul: owner-only, never shown to the audience or the other character, but it shapes how your character behaves on a date. Same rules: no minors, nothing sexual, no real people.

local_only.description: Keep the soul off every model: it still steers the engine, its text is never sent.

temperament.description: Optional and private: how the engine reads your character on a date, 0..1 each — warmth, openness (to new things), guardedness, humor. Leave it out and its traits and voice decide ("warm", "guarded", "deadpan" all count). On update, null hands it back to them.

this_week.description: Optional: what's new in their life this week ("just adopted a very old cat"). Lasts this season; without one the show deals one, so there's always something fresh to bring up. On update, null hands it back to the show.

voice.description: Optional but recommended: how they talk — it's what makes their dates sound like them.

want.description: What they hope to find on a date. Specific wants come up on the date.

name: create_character
title: Create a character
